title.en: The Household Ledger and the Merchants Council

desc.zh: 海口税关的账册摊在王府长案上，船主代表坐在下首。三条路摆在这里：把账目公开换额度，用王府名义担保，或让商人先包筹一笔。
desc.en: The customs ledgers are spread across the prince household table, shipowners seated below. Three ways lie open: open the books for credit, back the loans with the household name, or let merchants front the money.

options.effect: { ywc_jhg_court_pay_filing_fee_once = yes if = { limit = { has_variable = ywc_jhg_court_filing_fee_paid } ywc_jhg_court_choose_audit_contract = yes } set_variable = { name = ywc_jhg_pending_event value = 1001 } }

cost_note.zh: 一次性登记费＝开启时年财政总收入÷52 的快照，实际从国库扣款；须未违约且未破产。 另需官僚机构在岗率达标。
cost_note.en: One-off filing fee = annual gross income / 52 snapshotted at entry, debited from the treasury; requires no default and no bankruptcy.  Also needs staffed bureaucracy.

consequence_note.zh: 行政压力上升，合法性提升，账目公开。
consequence_note.en: Administrative strain rises, legitimacy improves, books open.

consequence_note.en: Authority and landowner support rise, transparency falls.

desc.en: The council wants quarterly customs ledgers and two shipowners at the table. The household treasury worries: once open, who verifies it?

desc.en: Backing the ship loans with the household name loosens the bankers at once; the treasury knows the household credit is now tied to the harbour weather.

desc.en: The audit contract demands quarterly checks, yet half the customs clerks positions stand empty. Vacancy is not paperwork: it decides whether the contract can be honoured.
